title: **Takfiri groups block Khash–Zahedan road**
text:
**Takfiri groups block Khash–Zahedan road**"

"🔹 Takfiri groups blocked the Khash–Zahedan road in the darkness of night, creating fear and panic and provoking the anger of local residents."

"🔹 The goal of these groups in such terrorist actions is the “Syriaization” of Iran. During the Syrian civil war, Takfiri groups blocked roads and used them to inspect vehicles, conduct ideological interrogations, and massacre civilians."

"🔹 Iranian public opinion remembers that Takfiris in Syria killed a Syrian truck driver because he was unfamiliar with the number of rak’ats [units] of prayer."

"🔹 The Armed Forces of the Islamic Republic have experience fighting international Takfiri groups on the borders of Iraq and Syria and, with strong intelligence dominance, will destroy the terrorists inside the country."

"*Note: The footage could not be verified.*
